description: This file defines a metrics API for distributed elastic training in PyTorch, including classes for configuration, metric handling, and stream management, as well as decorators and functions for profiling and publishing metrics.

classes.name: MetricHandler
classes.description: Abstract base class for metric handlers.

classes.name: ConsoleMetricHandler
classes.description: Handler that outputs metrics to console.

classes.name: MetricStream
classes.description: Represents a stream of metrics for a specific group.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the default or group-specific metric handler.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Retrieves a MetricStream for a given group.

methods.name: prof
methods.description: Decorator for profiling functions, publishing duration, success, and failure metrics.

methods.name: profile
methods.description: Deprecated decorator for profiling functions, similar to prof.

methods.name: put_metric
methods.description: Publishes a metric data point to a specified group.

methods.name: publish_metric
methods.description: Deprecated function for publishing metrics, use put_metric instead.

methods.name: get_elapsed_time_ms
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time in milliseconds from a start time.
